law.stateDefinition: delta = drive-output; this is elastic deflection, not knee flexion
law.domainWarning: The source states the fit/calibration domain is unknown. Above abs(delta)=101.7 deg the preserved simulation law is mathematically extrapolated. 101.7 deg and 6 Nm are normalization values, not hard limits or validation.
